svg.title: 1:1 notes between a manager and a report — SoftTrack web design mockup (#257)
svg.desc: A manager and a report meet every week or two, and what they agreed last time is in two private notebooks that do not match. A shared space per manager and report holds dated meetings, an agenda either can add to, notes and action items that carry over, and is read by the two people and nobody else.
svg.text: 1:1 notes between a manager and a report

g.text: Read by the two of you, and nobody else.

svg.text: Read by the two, and nobody else
Each person can keep private notes of their own beside the shared
ones. Those are read by one person.

g.text: The old space stays readable to the two people who wrote it. The
new manager starts a new one and cannot read the old.

svg.text: Done when each manager and report have a shared space with dated meetings, either can add agenda items beforehand, notes are markdown, action items have an owner and a
date and carry into the next meeting when not done, an action can become a ticket on a team both share, the space is read by the two people and nobody else, it closes when the
manager changes and stays readable to the two who wrote it, and both are reminded the day before.
